content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The architecture behind crypto payment gateways for digital products allows creators to bypass conventional platforms that often take substantial cuts of sales. By using NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction compared to competitors like Gumroad, which demands 10%, creators can retain a significant portion of their revenue. For instance, on 100 sales of a $97 product, the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-11|COREMERCH guide to difference]] saves the creator $921. This architecture is crucial for digital creators who need a reliable, cost-effective way to monetize their content without compromising their earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of this architecture involves a seamless integration of various decentralized technologies. A combination of free hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, alongside backend solutions such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, creates a robust framework. NOWPayments automates crypto payment processing, allowing instant transaction verification without the need for KYC or buyer accounts. This infrastructure not only lowers costs but also enhances security and ownership, granting creators full control over their digital storefronts and transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions underserved by traditional payment processors. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or digital art, this architecture provides an opportunity to monetize your work without the heavy fees imposed by platforms like Gumroad or PayPal. By leveraging this crypto payment gateway, creators can focus on what they do best—creating—while ensuring that the financial aspect of their business is secure and efficient, free from the constraints of restrictive platforms.
Save over $900 on fees by switching to NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The infrastructure comprises several key components that work in harmony. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting solution, while backend logic is handled by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. For data storage, Supabase or Google Sheets can be utilized, allowing for easy order management. File delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring fast access to digital products. Combined with NOWPayments for crypto transactions, this setup creates a comprehensive and efficient digital commerce stack that empowers creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture, start by selecting a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Store your order data in Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring easy access and management. For file delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions efficiently. For those looking for a complete solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which provides all necessary blueprints and templates for a successful deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, which allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies. This method bypasses conventional fees, maximizing your earnings. You can set up your store using platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, integrating automated delivery and payment verification.
Complete control over your digital sales infrastructure, no third-party platform required.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) can provide you with all the blueprints and templates needed to establish your own sovereign digital store. You can view this solution at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept crypto payments for my digital products?

You can accept crypto payments by integrating NOWPayments into your digital store. It allows for seamless payment processing in over 300 cryptocurrencies, ensuring that you retain more of your earnings with low fees.
What are the advantages of using crypto payment gateways?

Crypto payment gateways eliminate the high fees associated with traditional platforms and allow for global transactions without the need for KYC. This means more revenue for you and less dependence on restrictive platforms.
Is it difficult to set up a crypto payment system?

Setting up a crypto payment system is straightforward. With platforms like NOWPayments and hosting services like GitHub Pages, you can have your store operational in a short time. Documentation is available to guide you through the process.
Can I sell various digital products using this architecture?

Yes, this architecture supports a wide range of digital products including ebooks, courses, software, and templates. The flexibility of the system allows you to tailor it to your specific product offerings.
What support is available after deployment?

After deployment, you can rely on a 30-day support window for troubleshooting and setup assistance. Additionally, comprehensive documentation helps you manage and scale your digital store effectively.
